<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations/{conversationId}/encryption"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Either participant may toggle. A change records
`encryptionDisabledAt`/`encryptionDisabledById` and posts one
`SYSTEM_ENCRYPTION_DISABLED` / `SYSTEM_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED` message
(no push). Repeating the current state is a no-op. Family chat
returns 400 (`errors.chatEncryptionNotSupported`). The server accepts
plaintext and encrypted messages either way: the flag exists so the
choice is visible to both people.
